svg.text: Generalised Tic Tac Toe on a 4 × 5 board, K = 3 in a row
Board states printed by tik_tak_toe.c during one real game. win_check() scans rows, columns and both diagonals.
Input is validated per move (row 1–4, column 1–5, square must be free); a win is checked once enough moves have been made.
